title: Gancao Xiexin Decoction inhibits gastric carcinoma proliferation and migration by regulating the JAK2/STAT3 signalling pathway.
authors: Yang, Yating; Yuan, Ling; Meng, Fandi; Lu, Doudou; Che, Mengying; Zhou, Xin; Chen, Guoqing; Ning, Na; Nan, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过JAK2/STAT3信号通路抑制胃癌增殖迁移，仅涉及STAT3蛋白表达检测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The incidence of gastric carcinoma (GC) is increasing rapidly. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) plays a unique role in the treatment of GC. At present, Gancao Xiexin Decoction (GCXXD) has been proved to have a good therapeutic effect on diseases of the spleen and stomach system, but relevant molecular mechanisms remain incompletely explained. AIM OF STUDY: The mechanism of GCXXD for GC was investigated by network pharmacology and verified by cell experiments. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Firstly, the public database was used to identify the core targets and key pathways of GCXXD in treating GC, followed by molecular docking and survival analysis. Subsequently, the effects of GCXXD on human gastric cancer AGS and HGC-27 cells were confirmed by a series of experiments, such as CCK-8, colony formation, apoptosis, cell cycle, wound scratch assay, transwell chamber assay, qRT-PCR and Western blot. RESULTS: This study identified quercetin, wogonin, kaempferol, baicalein, sitosterol and beta-sitosterol as key ingredients, along with AKT1, TP53, JUN, STAT3, TNF, MAPK3, HSP90AA1 and EGFR as co targets, and the JAK/STAT signalling pathway as the key pathway. The experimental results showed that GCXXD inhibited the growth of GC cells, increased the apoptosis rate and the ratio of G0/G1 phase cells, and weakened the clone formation rate and inhibited cell migration and invasion. It also reduces the expression of core target genes and downregulates the expression of JAK2, p-JAK2, STAT3, and p-STAT3 proteins. CONCLUSION: GCXXD inhibits GC cell growth, reduces clonogenic capacity, induces apoptosis, blocks the cell cycle, and decreases cell migration and invasion rates by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 signalling pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：胃癌（GC）的发病率正在迅速增加。中医药（TCM）在胃癌治疗中发挥着独特作用。目前，甘草泻心汤（GCXXD）已被证明对脾胃系统疾病具有良好的治疗效果，但相关分子机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：通过网络药理学研究GCXXD治疗GC的机制，并通过细胞实验进行验证。材料与方法：首先，利用公共数据库识别GCXXD治疗GC的核心靶点和关键通路，随后进行分子对接和生存分析。接着，通过一系列实验，如CCK-8、集落形成、凋亡、细胞周期、伤口划痕实验、Transwell小室实验、qRT-PCR和Western blot，确认GCXXD对人胃癌AGS和HGC-27细胞的影响。结果：本研究鉴定出槲皮素、汉黄芩素、山柰酚、黄芩素、谷甾醇和β-谷甾醇为关键成分，同时AKT1、TP53、JUN、STAT3、TNF、MAPK3、HSP90AA1和EGFR为共同靶点，JAK/STAT信号通路为关键通路。实验结果显示，GCXXD抑制GC细胞生长，增加凋亡率和G0/G1期细胞比例，减弱集落形成率，并抑制细胞迁移和侵袭。它还降低核心靶基因的表达，并下调JAK2、p-JAK2、STAT3和p-STAT3蛋白的表达。结论：GCXXD通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路，抑制GC细胞生长、降低克隆形成能力、诱导凋亡、阻滞细胞周期，并降低细胞迁移和侵袭率。
